content: Duolingo streak freezes are capped (not unlimited) and applied silently/retroactively with no popup -- the user discovers protection after the fact. Design principle: an uncapped forgiveness mechanic stops being a safety net and becomes a substitute for the behavior; boundedness is what preserves the daily-commitment signal. Freezes are framed as reducing streak anxiety/churn while preserving the loss-aversion engagement engine, but Duolingo also monetizes freezes as purchases, which is the exploitative edge of the same mechanic.
